name: IQVIA
description: IQVIA does two jobs for drug and medical-device companies. It runs their clinical trials as an outsourced contract research organization (54% of FY2025 revenue), and it sells them data, software and analytics built on records covering about 90% of the world's pharmaceutical sales (41%), plus a small contract sales and medical-services arm (5%). The trials business is paid by the project over months or years against a $32.7B contracted backlog; the data business is mostly subscriptions and multi-year software and information contracts. Its clients are nearly all of the top 100 pharma and biotech companies, and no client exceeds about 5% of revenue. Two things are unusual: the data business is what lets it design trials and find patients faster than a plain CRO, and from January 1, 2026 it reports only two segments (Commercial Solutions and Research & Development Solutions) after folding Contract Sales into a combined commercial segment.

businessLines.name: Research & Development Solutions (R&DS)
businessLines.how: Drug developers sign service contracts for IQVIA to run a trial; revenue is recognised over time as costs are incurred against expected total cost (10-K), and reimbursed costs such as investigator payments are included in revenue. Contracts can be cancelled or delayed by the client, usually with wind-down fees.
businessLines.description: Outsourced clinical trial services for biopharmaceutical clients: project management and clinical monitoring (Phase I-IV), trial support services, central and specialty laboratory services, strategic planning and design, patient and site solutions (including the Avacare site network, over 180 investigators).

businessLines.name: Technology & Analytics Solutions (TAS)
businessLines.how: Mostly fixed-price information contracts: an ongoing subscription (typically one to three years, generally non-cancelable, revenue recognised ratably) and/or one-time data deliveries, plus SaaS, consulting and outsourcing projects (mostly one year or less).
businessLines.description: Cloud software (CRM, performance management, compliance, master data), real-world data and evidence, analytics and consulting, and information offerings (national sales and prescribing data in over 100 countries, a reference database of over 22 million healthcare professionals, Global Market Insight products such as MIDAS). From 2026 combined with Contract Sales & Medical Solutions into Commercial Solutions.

businessLines.name: Contract Sales & Medical Solutions (CSMS)
businessLines.how: Drug and device makers pay for contract sales representatives (revenue recognised by employee days worked), recruiting, and sales-force automation set-up and hosting; most of the revenue is staff cost, so profit margin is small.
businessLines.description: Outsourced sales teams and market-access staff for biopharma and device companies, nurse-based patient engagement programs, and medical services (field medical teams, publication strategy). Reported separately through FY2025; combined into Commercial Solutions from 2026.
